{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "Competent, appealing stylized drawing: recognizable horses, sun with rays, clouds, grandstand, tote board, and FINISH line are all clear. No blank, clipped, or malformed areas; flat but coherent style."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 4, "reason": "Meets all verifiable hard requirements: standalone SVG, 1200x800, no external assets or JS, valid XML, sky/track/grass, grandstand, tote board, photo-finish camera. Horses genuinely translate. Cannot fully confirm four distinct coat colors/silks from truncated source and overlapping image."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Inventive touches include a changing tote board, popping photo-finish flash, rotating sun rays, parallax cloud layers, waving flags, and a bobbing crowd — all fitting the race-day brief without feeling generic."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 5, "reason": "Motion genuinely works: horses translate horizontally toward the finish across all three captured frames, legs cycle through gallop poses, hooves kick dust, manes/tails flow, and the tote board, flash, clouds, flags, crowd, and sun all animate continuously."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 4, "reason": "Rich scene with five gradients, glow/soft blur filters, 570 elements, layered sky/track/grass, detailed grandstand, tote board, rails, and track markings. Stylized but well-layered with depth."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 4, "reason": "Balanced layered layout (sky, track, grass), harmonious blue/green palette, legible FINISH/PHOTO FINISH text, and clear visual hierarchy. Not cluttered; framing gives the horses room to race."},
  "summary": "A self-contained animated horse race with genuinely translating horses, a working photo-finish flash and changing tote board, meeting the brief with solid detail and balanced composition."
}
